statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 12 is in the low band and remains below the block threshold, with the single mapped danger window falling on Aug 28.
recommendation: The assessment eases after the cash close. NQ last printed 29,635.25 into the 21:00 UTC CME maintenance break, about 71 points below the 29,706.75 session high and below the 29,650.00 level of the previous run, so the marginal new high was not held and the retracement off it is still functioning. Tail therefore steps back from 14 to 12 and the dominant mode returns to mixed. The advance itself remains extraordinarily narrow, with only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members higher and technology the sole advancing S&P 500 sector, and VIX closed 14.51, down 4.60%, so implied volatility is decaying rather than confirming a trend. The after-hours session is two-sided rather than aligned: Workday fell about 5%, Autodesk about 6% and Rubrik about 10%, while Gap rose about 9% and Ulta about 2%. Stress eases marginally to 47 on decaying volatility, offset by narrow breadth and the event ahead. The mapped policy state is EA_ON. The single mapped danger window remains 14:00-15:30 UTC on Aug 28 around Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading, where a staged repricing is the specific structure capable of denying retracement. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unaffected by this assessment.
headline: NQ fades to 29,635.25 into the CME break, 71 points below its 29,706.75 high, as after-hours software weakness offsets the Nvidia-led close and Tail eases to 12
body:
Nasdaq-100 E-mini futures last printed 29,635.25, up 345.75 points or 1.18%, at 16:59:59 ET immediately before the 21:00 UTC CME maintenance break. The session range is 29,401.75-29,706.75 against a 29,499.50 open. The structural change since the previous assessment is that the extension to 29,706.75 was not held: the contract traded 29,650.00 an hour ago and has since eased a further 15 points, leaving it about 71 points below the high. That is a functioning retracement, and it is the reason the dominant mode returns from trend-up to mixed and Tail eases from 14 to 12. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed at 29,641.56, up 417.04 points or 1.43%, on a 29,366.42-29,643.53 range against a 29,224.52 prior close, so the cash close near the high remains an observed fact of the completed session while the futures path after it did not extend.

The composition of the advance continues to argue against a pathological index-level path. The Nasdaq Composite closed 26,541.35, up 1.57%, and the S&P 500 7,730.99, up 0.72%, while the Dow gained only 0.20% to 53,569.44. Technology was the sole advancing S&P 500 sector at about 3.4%, the semiconductor index rose about 2.3%, and only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members were higher. Nvidia rose about 8.7% on its revenue guidance. An index carried by a handful of names is more reversible than a broad advance. The after-hours session adds a genuine counterweight that did not exist at the previous run: Workday fell about 5% on subscription guidance, Autodesk about 6%, Rubrik about 10% and Marvell about 2% despite a beat, while Gap rose about 9%, Ulta about 2% and Affirm gained. Two Nasdaq-100 members falling 5-6% after the bell is a two-sided overnight input rather than an aligned continuation signal.

Cross-assets remain consistent rather than aligned into a single amplifier. VIX closed 14.51, down 0.70 points or 4.60%, on a 14.42-15.13 range and well below the 15.21 prior close, so implied volatility is decaying. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.67% and the 2-year 4.24%, firmer by roughly two and one and a half basis points, against Federal Reserve H.15 closes of 4.66% and 4.19% for Aug 26. WTI crude is $83.54, up 1.59%, and Brent $89.59, up 1.99%, with the move driven by two-sided geopolitical positioning between Middle East supply diplomacy and Russia-Ukraine risk rather than by a single discontinuity. None of these amplifiers is aligned with the others in the way that would justify a step into the block band.

Forward risk stays concentrated in one window. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00 UTC on Aug 28, alongside the final August Michigan sentiment reading, with Chicago PMI 15 minutes earlier at 13:45 UTC. A first keynote by a new chair is structurally multi-stage, with a prepared text, delivery and a subsequent bond-market reaction, and a delayed second leg is the mechanism most capable of denying mean reversion. Conditional Tail therefore steps to 22 and 21 across 14:00-15:30 UTC and then falls back on the assumption of orderly two-way price discovery. Ahead of that, the overnight run holds a 10-12 conditional floor through the maintenance break, the Globex reopen, the Asian session and the European morning. The shared Finviz cross-asset context was collected at 13:07 UTC, roughly eight hours before this assessment, so it is outside the freshness window and was not used as evidence; every figure above comes from independent current sources.

lookbackSummary: The window runs from 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 to 20:00 UTC on Aug 27 and covers the digestion of the Nvidia release into a technology-led advance and its close. It opens on an unavailable hour, then two published hours at Tail 18 and 16 as the post-release repricing proved orderly overnight. From 01:00 UTC the assessment stepped down through 13 and 12 to a 10-11 plateau that held across the Asian and European sessions, with Stress easing from 60 to 45. The U.S. session added only modest firmness: Tail 14 at the 13:00 UTC pre-open hour, then 12, 12 and 11 through the afternoon, a trend-up read at 14 in the 17:00 UTC hour as the index pressed higher, 11 and 12 into the close, and 14 with a second trend-up read in the 20:00 UTC closing hour. Three hours are unavailable, at 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27, where no assessment was published. Across the whole window the mapping stayed at EA_ON and no hour produced the persistent no-retracement structure that Tail measures.
outlookSummary: The horizon runs from 21:00 UTC today to 20:00 UTC on Aug 28 and contains an empty overnight and a single genuine catalyst cluster. The current hour is the CME maintenance break, so no continuous price path exists inside it and conditional Tail sits at the horizon low of 10. The Globex reopen at 22:00 UTC is the first hour to price the after-hours split between software weakness and semiconductor strength, and a 10-12 conditional floor then holds across the Tokyo and Hong Kong opens and the Asian afternoon. Conditional scores lift gradually from the 06:00 UTC European run-in through the 07:00 UTC cash open to 12-13 as liquidity and pre-event positioning build, with month-end on Aug 31 adding mechanical flow on the final Friday. The cluster is at 13:00-15:00 UTC: the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC and Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC, then Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote and the final Michigan sentiment reading together at 14:00 UTC. Conditional Tail peaks at 22 and 21 across the mapped 14:00-15:30 UTC danger window, the only slots mapped to WATCH, before easing to 17 and then back to 12-14 on the assumption that price discovery is orderly and retracements function. Repeated extension after failed pullbacks in that window would be the invalidation.
